verification.notes: Show HN rules documented: must be something people can try, not a landing page. ~80-char title guidance is heuristic (truncation), not a published limit.

body.notes: URL or text — not both as a link post

links.notes: Submission is a URL or a text post. Show HN should link to something usable; a text body can complement for context.

postingRules: Show HN requires something users can actually try (product, repo, demo) — not waitlists or landing pages
Do not ask for upvotes; do not use voting rings
Resubmitting is allowed only after significant time and with genuine changes
One Show HN per project launch; follow-ups only for major milestones

rateLimit.notes: Aggressive submission filters exist; accounts flagged for spam get submissions killed silently.

works: 'Show HN: X – what it does' titles
